purpose: Declare one test per AC of US-19102 (FBS-223) driving rcf audit separation flags through bin/rcf.js and checking the pull_request CI wiring, so the FBS-223 Define round turns each declaration into a red test; AC-19102-4 and AC-19102-5 carry the CI-wiring criteria.
title: Separation wiring: Hand: mixed with Separation-Reason, rcf/separation.json class override, --require-hand, and the pull_request CI step with full-depth checkout

testCases.description: rcf audit separation passes a Hand: mixed commit with Separation-Reason as an exception (exceptions 1, --json verdict "exception"); Hand: mixed without a reason exits 4 with "mixed without Separation-Reason"
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation-stage-prefix.test.js::AC-19604-3: a Hand: mixed trailer fails "<s7> Hand: mixed is retired; commit chores as FINALISE: within its file classes" with or without Separation-Reason, whatever the commit touches

testCases.description: rcf audit separation with rcf/separation.json { classes: { test: ["spec/**"] } } exits 4 naming spec/a.js for a builder commit; a malformed rcf/separation.json exits 2 naming the file; a builder edit to it fails as a criteria-class touch
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation-stage-prefix.test.js::AC-19604-5: configured classes win (rcfTest on spec/**), the 0.36.x name test is read as rcfTest with a warn line, an unknown class and unparsable JSON exit 2

testCases.description: rcf audit separation --require-hand exits 4 naming the commit and the missing trailer for a commit with no Hand: trailer or a Hand: builder commit with no Hand-Id: trailer
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation-stage-prefix.test.js::AC-19604-4: rcf audit separation --require-hand exits 2 with "[error] usage --require-hand is retired; every commit needs a stage prefix" and prints nothing on stdout

testCases.description: on pull_request, CI runs node bin/rcf.js audit separation --base origin/${{ github.base_ref }} from packages/rcf-lite after checkout fetch-depth 0 and its exit code fails the job; the step does not run on push to main
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation-wiring.test.js::AC-19102-4: on pull_request, CI runs node bin/rcf.js audit separation --base origin/${{ github.base_ref }} from packages/rcf-lite after checkout fetch-depth 0 and its exit code fails the job; the step does not run on push to main

testCases.description: an empty or whitespace Separation-Reason never turns Hand: mixed into a pass, and rcf audit separation on a shallow checkout exits 2 naming the missing base
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation-stage-prefix.test.js::AC-19604-6: no trailer turns a failing commit into a pass: "BUILD: add test" fails with its class item under no trailer, Hand: test-author or Hand: mixed with a reason, and a commit marked only by a Hand: trailer fails "no stage prefix"

testCases.description: rcf audit separation --require-hand exits 4 naming the missing Hand: trailer for a commit with no Hand: trailer that also touches test and production
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation-stage-prefix.test.js::AC-19604-4: rcf audit separation --require-hand exits 2 with "[error] usage --require-hand is retired; every commit needs a stage prefix" and prints nothing on stdout

testCases.description: rcf audit separation --require-hand exits 4 naming the missing Hand-Id: trailer for a Hand: builder commit with no Hand-Id: trailer that also touches a test path
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation-stage-prefix.test.js::AC-19604-4: rcf audit separation --require-hand exits 2 with "[error] usage --require-hand is retired; every commit needs a stage prefix" and prints nothing on stdout
